rowText.steps: From the tab strip, press Down into the slot row, press Down again.
rowText.expected: Lands on the transcript (or the preset row if the chat is empty); Up retraces.

verdictSentence: Pressing down twice from the tab strip takes you to the slot row, then into the chat text below it, and pressing up once takes you straight back to the slot row, so the down and up path matches.
